snippet.title: Silicon Architect - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4658620/Silicon_Architect

Silicon Architect is an incremental hardware engineering game with a Windows XP themed UI. Configure and optimize processor components, build your own CPU, and run automated benchmarks. Harvest telemetry and gather research funding to unlock new hardware, and scale your processing power.
